verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents its own deployment options that control where data lives: it is open-source and deployable to any on-premise infrastructure or a user's own Kubernetes cluster, it offers Private Cloud and On Prem tiers, and it delivers data into the user's own BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift warehouse. However, no evidence shows a region or residency selector for the hosted Jitsu Cloud (including its provisioned ClickHouse or Kafka buffering), so residency choice is mainly achieved by self-hosting. Missing for 10: documented region/residency selection for Jitsu Cloud and its provisioned storage, explicit data-residency documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
